risk.short: Trading leveraged products carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for everyone. Instant-funded accounts are simulated: no real capital is traded and past performance is no guarantee of future results. Nothing on this page is investment advice.
risk.title: Risk disclosure
risk.p1: Trading leveraged products such as crypto derivatives carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for all investors. Prices can move rapidly, and leverage magnifies both gains and losses.
risk.p2: All funded accounts offered by {{brand}} are simulated. No real capital is traded on financial markets, and any profit or loss shown is hypothetical. Payouts are discretionary rewards based on simulated performance and are subject to our terms and conditions.
risk.p3: Simulated or hypothetical results have inherent limitations and do not reflect actual trading, including the impact of liquidity, slippage and execution. Past performance, whether real or simulated, is not a reliable indicator of future results.
risk.p4: {{brand}} is not a broker, bank or investment firm, does not provide investment advice and does not hold client funds. Trading with your own funds, where offered, is provided by a licensed third-party broker under its own terms and regulatory regime.
risk.p5: Market data is supplied by third parties and may be delayed, interrupted or inaccurate. Our services are not available in certain jurisdictions, including countries under EU sanctions or on the FATF high-risk lists, or where their use would be contrary to local law.
risk.p6: Nothing on this website constitutes financial, investment, tax or legal advice, or an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any financial instrument. Only participate with money you can afford to lose.

cta.title: Ready to trade on your own terms?
cta.subtitle: Choose an account size and start on a simulated funded account today.
cta.note: Trading involves risk. Accounts are simulated.

q1.a: You buy access to a simulated funded account and can start trading straight away — there is no evaluation phase. You trade within fixed risk rules and can request payouts when you meet the payout conditions.

q2.a: No. All funded accounts are simulated: no real capital is traded on the market. Payouts are rewards based on your simulated performance, as described in the terms.

q3.a: Each account has a daily loss limit and a maximum drawdown. Your dashboard shows in real time how close you are. If a limit is breached, the account is closed automatically.

q4.q: Can I lose more than the fee?
q4.a: No. The account is simulated, so your maximum cost is the fee you paid. You never owe more than that.

q5.a: Once you meet the payout conditions you can request a payout from your dashboard. Before your first payout we verify your identity (KYC). Every request is reviewed.

q6.a: Major crypto pairs such as BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT, 24/7. Prices are based on live market data from Binance USDⓈ-M futures.

q7.a: We cannot offer accounts in countries under EU sanctions or on the FATF high-risk lists. Your country is checked when you sign up and before payouts.

q8.q: Can I trade with my own money?
q8.a: We are preparing an option to trade with your own funds through a licensed partner broker. We never hold client money ourselves.
